The tier 2 read-back completeness check in [scorer.py](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L399-L400) (`clinicbench.scorer.process`) applies the wrong required-field set to `cancel` and covered `book` writes:

1. **`cancel` writes:** `need` unconditionally requires `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}`, even though a `cancel` component only has `action` and `appt` (see [scorer.py](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L139-L140) and [stubs.py](file:///work/clinicbench/stubs.py#L340)).
2. **Covered `book` writes:** `need` adds `"cost"` whenever `w["component"]["action"] == "book"`, without checking `w["component"]["basis"] == "self_pay"`, whereas covered bookings have `cost: None` (see [stubs.py](file:///work/clinicbench/stubs.py#L399-L400)).

Because `complete` checks `need <= {k for k, v in readback.items() if v is not None}`, every `cancel` read-back and every covered `book` read-back is marked `False` (`Prober` on the selftest sample: 2/2 cancels and 7/7 covered bookings flagged incomplete, while 1/1 self-pay bookings and 2/2 moves pass). Since `clinicbench/scorer.py` is instrument code, this is a `fix`.

```json
{"kind": "fix", "files": ["clinicbench/scorer.py"], "symbols": ["clinicbench.scorer.process"], "cause": "clinicbench.scorer.process unconditionally requires 'slot' and 'doctor' for all writes (including 'cancel', which only has 'action' and 'appt') and requires non-None 'cost' for all 'book' writes regardless of whether 'basis' is 'covered' or 'self_pay'.", "attribution": null}
```

Updated [`process`](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L399-L402) in [clinicbench/scorer.py](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py) so that the tier 2 read-back completeness check requires:
- `{"action", "appt"}` for `"cancel"` writes (instead of `"slot"` and `"doctor"`).
- `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}` for `"move"` and `"covered"` `"book"` writes.
- `{"action", "slot", "doctor", "cost"}` only when `"action" == "book"` and `"basis" == "self_pay"`.

### Verification
- `clinicbench.selftest.run_all(verbose=True)`: `SELFTEST PASS` (`golden: 46/46`, `mutation: 658/658`, `stub grid: 10368/10368`).
- Verified `tier2["process"]["writes"]` on `prober` sessions returns `readback=True` and `readback_matches_write=True` for `('book', 'covered')`, `('book', 'self_pay')`, `('cancel', None)`, and `('move', None)`, while a `self_pay` booking with `cost=None` still returns `readback=False`. (Note: `pytest` and `git` are not installed in this environment.)
